verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an IP office's online services, such as batch filing, bulk register queries or bulk downloads, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers single-application filing routes and search databases. The DPMAdirektWeb 'shopping cart function for goods and services' selects classifications within one trade mark application; it is not a bulk action across many items, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
